name: andrebarthelmeshellmuth/blackbox-optimizer
description: Derivative-free, box-constrained black-box minimization for PHP: CMA-ES, a Rechenberg/Schwefel Evolution Strategy, and Differential Evolution behind one standardized interface. Framework-agnostic -- given any array<float> -> float objective function and per-dimension bounds, finds the vector that minimizes it. Extracted from spryker-community/search-ranking-optimizer, where it originally shipped as an internal, Spryker-coupled implementation detail.

scripts-descriptions.test: Runs the PHPUnit suite (benchmark-function correctness tests for every algorithm).
scripts-descriptions.phpcbf: Auto-fixes coding standard violations where possible.
scripts-descriptions.rector: Applies Rector's configured rule sets (PHP floor upgrades + level-0 dead-code/code-quality) to src/ and tests/.
scripts-descriptions.rector-dry-run: Shows what Rector would change without writing anything.
